question: Bihu is the popular dance form of which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __Assam__.

__
 
• 'Bihu' is a folk dance of Assam__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Bihu:

 
 
• It is the festival of Assam.
 
• At the Bihu festival, the people celebrate the change in seasons.
 
• The festival state and marks the beginning of Assamese New Year and harvest season.
 
• There are three types of Bihu that are celebrated during different time periods.
 
 
• Rongali or Bohag Bihu comes in April.
 
• Kogali or Kati Bihu is observed in October.
 
• Bhogali or Magh Bihu is celebrated in January. 
 
 
 
• Bihu is a folk dance that is done during the Bihu festival.
